name: hcapp_saveHashTrash
description: Creates or updates the HashTrash article for a run. HashTrash is a headline + markdown article written per run by mismanagement. Status 0 = draft (mismanagement only); 1 = published (visible to all). Only the three HashTrash columns on HC.Event are touched — UpdatedAt is deliberately NOT updated so that the sync pipeline does not re-distribute the event row to all clients. Auth: Hash Flash (0x20), WebMeister (0x1000), or GM (0x02) — bitmask 0x1022. New feature — no HC5 equivalent.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel that owns the event. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event to write HashTrash for. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error. If no event matches eventId + kennelId (or it is deleted), returns errorCode 4040, errorType 3.

parameters.name: headline
parameters.description: Short article headline. Required — empty or whitespace-only triggers validation error. The table column type is inferred from the SP parameter type (NVARCHAR(500)).

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Markdown body of the article. May be NULL or empty — the validation only requires @headline. No length limit.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: 0 = draft (mismanagement-only visibility); 1 = published (all users). Any other value triggers validation error (errorCode 1234, errorType 2). The SP validates @status NOT IN (0, 1) — note this means @status IS NULL also triggers the error.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Compact error envelope returned on auth, validation, role check, event-not-found, or unhandled errors: { success=0, errorCode, errorType }. Followed by StandardErrorResult at index 1. Mutually exclusive with SuccessEnvelope rowset.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on successful save: { success=1, errorCode=NULL, errorType=NULL }. Mutually exclusive with ErrorEnvelope rowset.
Returned at index 1 alongside the ErrorEnvelope (index 0) on any error.

sideEffects: Updates HC.Event: sets HashTrashHeadline, HashTrashContent, HashTrashStatus where id + kennelId match and deleted = 0. Deliberately does NOT update UpdatedAt to avoid triggering event sync distribution.
Writes to HC.ErrorLog on auth, validation, role, event-not-found, or unhandled errors.

codeSmells.issue: Intentional UpdatedAt omission bypasses sync pipeline — must be documented in caller
codeSmells.detail: The SP deliberately omits UpdatedAt from the UPDATE SET clause so the sync system does not re-distribute this event row to all clients. This is a deliberate design choice but callers must be aware that after a HashTrash save, the Event row will NOT be re-synced to device SQLite databases. HashTrash must always be fetched on-demand via this SP, never read from local sync data.

codeSmells.issue: @status NULL treated as invalid by NOT IN (0, 1) check
codeSmells.detail: The validation uses @status NOT IN (0, 1). In SQL Server, NULL NOT IN (0, 1) evaluates to UNKNOWN, which is treated as TRUE in a WHERE/IF predicate, so a NULL @status will trigger the validation error. This is the correct behaviour but may surprise callers that expect NULL to be handled separately.
